# Studio Naomikaa

> Studio Naomikaa is a Hyderabad-based interior design studio in Kondapur, founded by Brishti Roy. The studio provides planning-first interior design for homes, apartments, hotels, offices, cafés and retail spaces across India.

## Company
- Name: Studio Naomikaa
- Founder & Principal Designer: Brishti Roy
- Phone: +91 83060 97049
- Email: studionaomikaa@gmail.com
- Website: https://studionaomikaa.in/
- Service area: India
- Studio location: Vasantha Blooms, Kondapur, JV Hills, Hyderabad, Telangana 500084, India
